scope: One confirmed redundant hash in ConcurrentHashMap erase. No public API/ABI/locking/reclamation algorithm change; no external peer speed claim.

mechanism.before: Wrapper hashes key to choose shard, table.erase hashes same query again while shard lock is held.
mechanism.after: Wrapper reuses hash through private FlatHashMap::erase_prehashed; the original probe, slot destruction, tombstone update and shard unlock order remain.
mechanism.query_admission: Private helper retains original const Hash and Eq noexcept constraints, including Hash even though it is not invoked there; outer/public query signatures unchanged.
mechanism.ordinary_flat_map: Public FlatHashMap erase still hashes once only when allocated, and returns without hashing at zero capacity.
mechanism.counter_limit: CountingHash is a single-thread diagnostic with stable returned hash. Exact user-hasher invocation count is not a new public API guarantee; no counter or counter atomics are in the formal trace.

trace.platform: Windows; existing MSVC14.50.35717 toolchain and current static foundation cache
trace.compiler_flags: /O2 /Ob2 /DNDEBUG /std:c++latest /MD /W4 /WX; HYLE_STATIC; no sanitizer, trace or test instrumentation
trace.affinity: Logical CPU4 explicitly pinned and observed; no physical-core/P/E assertion
trace.keys: Fixed generation and shuffle seeds, unique owning std::string keys, string_view erase queries, fixed hash seed 0x71236ab4
trace.work: 8192 successful public erase calls per sample; final erased count and empty map checked for every sample
trace.timed: erase hashes/probes, key equality, shard lock/unlock, slot/key destruction and owned string deallocation
trace.excluded: key generation, map construction/reserve, key copies/insertion/refill, final checks and map destruction

interpretation: Both representative AB/BA pairs have lower candidate medians (~12.8/14.2% throughput ratio improvement), but baseline A/A medians drifted ~12.1%. Preserve every raw sample; no cross-process CI, universal benefit, hash-only timing attribution, model throughput, or external peer win is claimed. Source work elimination and exact diagnostic count are independently confirmed.
build: Only fresh probe TUs (frozen old/new two-header include overlays) and two current test TUs; same existing foundation static libraries. No CMake reconfigure/build, dependency download, SDK copy or product library rebuild.

remaining_readonly_candidates.observation: At exhausted growth budget the map rebuilds same capacity whenever live size is below 7/8 capacity; allocates control+slots and rehashes all live entries. Near threshold this may produce frequent full rebuilds. Not measured and not a confirmed loss.
remaining_readonly_candidates.coverage_gap: Existing bounded churn uses a 256-key universe or the same erased key7; benchmark erase includes a fresh build. Neither establishes high-occupancy rolling new-key behavior.
remaining_readonly_candidates.next: If pursued, first count allocations/rehashed keys on one fixed-cardinality trace and record actual slots/headroom. Do not compare speed if peer grows to more slots without reporting that memory-policy difference.

remaining_readonly_candidates.observation: No current same-contract loss confirmed. Sharded empty pop scans every shard by its contract; capacity is shards*per-shard, unlike single ring. Existing unbounded4P4C result does not cover bounded/retry policies.
remaining_readonly_candidates.next: Only select matched FIFO, exact capacity, wait/retry policy and persistent worker lifecycle before any representative test.

remaining_readonly_candidates.observation: Default node map retains retired tables without a read-side reclamation guard; AfterReaders is explicit. Old read-only membership peer oneTBB concurrent_unordered_set cannot be used as safe concurrent erase evidence.

reproduce: run.py build-baseline / build-candidate / count --variant ... / tests / perf --variant ... --tag ... ; source overlays and exact command/stdout/stderr preserved.
